notes:
Access: plain curl_cffi (chrome131 impersonation) direct HTTP fetch throughout, no block. Discovery: fetched sitemap_2-category.xml (2189 URLs) and grepped for clearance/outlet/sale/annex/closeout/open-box keywords; also scanned the homepage mega-nav (its internal tracking icid is 'MM-SALE-AND-CLEARANCE_SALE-AND-CLEARANCE' but the customer-facing label is only 'Sale' - there is no separate visible 'Clearance' nav item). Tested direct URL guesses /clearance/ (404), /last-chance/, /final-sale/, /discontinued/ (all 410 Gone), /annex/ (410), /lumens-annex/ (200 but canonical redirects to homepage - not a real page). qty taken from the site's rendered N-Results header (== data-cnstrc-num-results), the same mechanism exhaustion-tested and proven exact in the prior Home-Decor pass on this site. CLEARANCE VS SALE JUDGMENT (the brief's central test) - EXCLUDED as generic temporary promotions, not clearance: /sale/ (h1 'Modern Lighting + Furniture Promotions', 66,379 results = essentially the whole catalog on percent-off), /lighting/on_sale/, /furniture/on_sale/, /fans/on_sale/, /outdoor-and-landscape/on_sale/, /home-decor/on_sale/ (same generic on-sale filter, per top-level category), /promo_sale_event_j/, /promo-sale-event-i/, /promo-sale-event/ (h1s literally 'Promo Sale Event J/I' - internal rotating-campaign codenames), /sale_m/, /sale_n/ (h1 'Sale M'/'Sale N', same pattern), /best-of-sale/ and /weekend-sale/ and /winter-sale/ (all return 0 results / 'No results found' - expired campaigns), /coupons-and-promotions/ (a coupon-code article, not a product listing). Also excluded /outlets/ (33 results) - confirmed by product names (Legrand Adorne, Radiant GFCI/USB receptacles) this is a literal electrical-wall-outlets product category, unrelated to the clearance/outlet-store sense. TWO ROWS KEPT BUT FLAGGED AMBIGUOUS per brief instruction (uncertain, recorded rather than guessed): (1) /open-box/ - a permanent taxonomy node (present in the category sitemap, not a campaign/content page) selling like-new returned stock at a discount tier - functionally clearance-adjacent but never uses the literal words Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale on-page. (2) /warehouse-sale/ - visible copy reads like a time-bound percent-off campaign ('SAVE Up To 75% Now'), but its own <meta name="keywords"> tag is literally 'Warehouse Sale, End Of the Year Clearance Sale' - the site's own internal SEO metadata names it Clearance. Site search not queried (Disallow: /search* is under the generic '*' robots group; sitemap + full nav scan already surfaced every clearance-shaped candidate).

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11 PASS 3] Removed 1 Open Box row(s) per user directive: Open Box is not Clearance.
